target.statement: For every two admissible finite reduced typed-intervention experiments in the declared binary-symmetric-channel subcategory, equality of their passive retained (R,O) law implies isomorphism of their reduced protocol-indexed retained response experiments.
target.quantifiers: For all reduced experiments Red(P) and Red(Q) arising from admissible finite binary-symmetric-channel presentations P and Q with retained nodes (R,O), if Ubar_pass(Red(P)) and Ubar_pass(Red(Q)) have the same complete passive retained joint law up to an admitted typed boundary relabeling, then Red(P) and Red(Q) are isomorphic as reduced intervention experiments by an identity-preserving protocol-monoid isomorphism intertwining every retained response law up to one admitted typed boundary relabeling.
domains: FinTIP_(R,O)^iso objects are finite nonempty typed causal presentations P=(V,tau,(X_v),G,(kappa_v),r,o) with finite nonempty state spaces, a finite DAG, normalized local Markov kernels, distinguished retained-state and record nodes, and every finite hard intervention.
The declared BSC subcategory contains binary chains R->E->O with R~Bernoulli(1/2), edge kernels C_a and C_b, and their operational reductions by all partial hard assignments.
For each presentation P, A_P is the finite monoid of partial hard assignments under total right override, and Phi_P maps each context to the complete retained (R,O) joint law.
codomains: FinObs_(R,O)^iso contains finite retained objects (X_R,X_O,P_RO) with typed boundary relabelings.
FinRIE_(R,O)^iso contains finite reduced intervention experiments (behavioral classes, quotient multiplication, retained responses) with identity-preserving response-intertwining isomorphisms.
target.regularity: Finite exact setting only: all state spaces and context monoids are finite, every local kernel and induced law is normalized, and all executable probabilities are exact rational numbers.
measures: Counting measure on every finite state space.
Normalized finite probability mass functions for observational and hard-intervention laws.
boundary_conditions: The retained boundary is the ordered pair (R,O), and retained laws are complete joint tables in lexicographic order (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1).
The load-bearing witness pair uses the same nodes R,E,O, the same roles and binary cardinalities, the same chain R->E->O, and the same mediator intervention target E.
symmetries: Raw isomorphisms are type-preserving node bijections with state-space bijections that fix retained roles, preserve the DAG, transport every local kernel, and intertwine every hard intervention.
Reduced isomorphisms use identity-preserving protocol-monoid isomorphisms and one of the four typed binary boundary state relabelings on R and O.
No autonomous-agency, ontological-canonicity, continuum, gauge, soft-intervention, or physical-identification symmetry is admitted.
target.equivalence: For contexts i and j in A_P, i ==_P j exactly when Phi_P(u star i star v)=Phi_P(u star j star v) for every u,v in A_P, where star is total right override. Red(P) is the quotient monoid A_P/==_P with the descended retained response map. Two reduced experiments are isomorphic exactly under the identity, multiplication, and typed-boundary response-preservation conditions stated in the frozen design.
premises: Finite hard interventions replace selected local kernels by point masses and leave every other mechanism unchanged.
Ubar_pass retains the identity-class complete joint response and forgets every nonidentity protocol class.
The admitted BSC parameter pairs (a,b)=(1/4,1/3) and (1/3,1/4) are objects of the declared subcategory.
Intervened responses are compared as complete joint tables, including zero cells; no conditioning on null events is used.
modeling_postulates: The raw finite typed category and its BSC subcategory are declared mathematical model classes and are not asserted to be ontologically canonical.
permitted_theorems: Finite probability normalization and exact rational arithmetic.
Elementary finite DAG factorization and truncated-product intervention identities.
Elementary monoid, congruence, quotient, groupoid, functor, and isomorphism arguments.
A single admitted counterexample refutes a universal implication.
target.falsification_criterion: The universal target is refuted by two admitted reduced experiments with equal passive retained law but no identity-preserving response-intertwining reduced-experiment isomorphism under any admitted typed boundary relabeling. A proposed witness is invalidated by constructing such an isomorphism or by showing that either presentation falls outside the frozen domain.
target.literature_policy: This finite internal theorem may rely on the committed design and prior repository certificates. Any later external reliance must use a current primary source with an exact statement and hypothesis mapping; no priority or ontology claim is in scope.
